about: Skill DEFINITIONS (data, Combat 2026-10-12; Lead's everything-as-data series, item 5). One row per skill, keyed by id. SIM fields (they move a fight or a record, so they reach the sim digest): code (the record byte, append only, 1..n; 0 is none), move (the MoveId it fires: a verb in moves.ts MOVES, whose timing numbers stay engine-side), opponent (the opponent whose kill offers it, null = never offered), dayOne (the hero's starting skill, exactly one row), tell (an AI tellReaction answers it). PRESENTATION fields (Characters owns more of these; none reaches the digest): name (the label), clip (which legacy attack clip it plays: heavy, thrust or light), impactTint (the landed-blow flash colour; absent = no generic flash), bash (the hilt-bash clip on the weapons that have one), fx (a code verb a skill module answers to: witchfire, miasma, charge). A new skill is ONE row here plus its MoveDef verb.
